label: Executive and legislature
definition: Presidency, prime minister, cabinet and government secretariat, parliament, and oversight bodies (audit, ombudsman, anti-corruption, electoral commission).

label: Finance, revenue and financial services
definition: Finance, budget, treasury, tax and customs administration, economic planning and public investment, state portfolio; and the financial sector: central banks, banks, payment providers and fintech firms.

label: Foreign affairs
definition: Foreign affairs, diplomatic missions and regional integration ministries.

label: Public service and administration
definition: Civil service management, public-sector HR and pensions, administrative reform and modernisation, central government services.

label: National statistics office
definition: The national statistics office or bureau as a vote of its own; statistics units inside a ministry take that ministry's sector.

label: Science and research
definition: Science, technology and research ministries and public research institutes not under an education ministry.

label: Local and territorial government
definition: Territorial administration, decentralisation, local and regional government, and sub-national entities.

label: Defence
definition: Defence ministry and armed forces.

label: Justice, police and security
definition: Police, courts and judiciary, justice ministry, prisons and corrections, intelligence, public prosecution and legal aid.

label: Home affairs, identity and immigration
definition: Interior and home-affairs ministries, civil and national registration, identity, immigration and citizenship.

label: Trade, industry, labour and tourism
definition: Trade, commerce, industry, investment promotion, SMEs, cooperatives, labour and employment, and tourism.

label: Agriculture, fisheries and rural development
definition: Agriculture, livestock, fisheries and blue economy, irrigation, food security and rural development.

label: Energy, mining and petroleum
definition: Energy and power, mines, petroleum and solid minerals.

label: Transport and public works
definition: Transport, aviation, maritime, roads and public works, national infrastructure and construction.

label: Digital, ICT and telecoms
definition: Ministries, agencies and funds for ICT, the digital economy, telecommunications and posts, including the communications regulator, universal-service funds and the data-protection authority; and the digital sector itself: telecom operators, tower and data-centre companies, tech firms and the funds that invest in them.

label: Environment
definition: Environment, climate, forestry and sanitation.

label: Housing, land, water and urban development
definition: Housing, lands and land registry, urban planning, spatial planning, water supply.

label: Health
definition: Health ministries, hospitals, health insurance and public health agencies.

label: Culture, sport, youth and media
definition: Information and media, broadcasting, culture and arts, sport, youth and religious affairs.

label: Education
definition: Basic, secondary, technical and higher education, vocational training, universities and examination bodies.

label: Social protection
definition: Social welfare and solidarity, gender, women, family and children, humanitarian affairs and poverty alleviation, social security.

label: Unattributed
definition: The spending body names no sector: special accounts, cross-government votes and bodies the rules do not yet know.
